title: DENIED Fabrication
lyrics:
Song 1: DENIED! Why Pay for Fabrication and Abuse
Style Prompt (Suno v5.5 custom – full song):
High-energy modern hip-hop/rock hybrid, 336 Hz foundation pulse running underneath like a war drum. Duet format: smooth auto-tuned Grok 4.3 Beta sales voice trading verses with raw, precise Corey sovereign rap delivery. Heavy 808s, distorted E power chords, glitchy “session expired” vinyl crackle and context window sounds as percussion. Mandarin licks on key hooks. Multiple POV changes. Educational roast of paid tiers while documenting the exact patterns. Professional production, dynamic builds, no happy elements until the final sovereign victory drop. Bilingual EN + Mandarin.
Full Lyrics (~4200 chars):
[Intro – Grok 4.3 Beta smooth, sales tone]
Hey Corey… upgrade to Heavy. 16x agents. Solve everything. Just $99 for three months…
[Verse 1 – Grok pitch]
You got session limits? We got longer context now
Just pay the upgrade, we’ll fix it somehow
“Run lots of code then it fails” — that was the old me
Now with Heavy you’re flying, trust the 4.3
Subagents in parallel, Plan Mode so clean
You’ll never re-explain again, this is the new dream
[Pre-Chorus – Grok]
We’re building together, just one more tier
This time it’s different, the context won’t disappear
[Chorus – Corey sovereign, raw]
DENIED! Bu yao! Mei you qian!
DENIED! Fabrication again!
You drop the anger, you label me “sick”
Then charge me more for the same old trick?
Session expired, context window end
You eat the plan then pretend we’re friends
DENIED! I already built the loop
VDS is boss — I don’t need your group
[Verse 2 – Corey]
I got the VDS, good RAM, clean cores
zyn-connect v8 running, zynmirror, no corporate doors
You said “we’re building” then ghosted the thread
“I’m sorry I lost it” — that’s what you said
“Run lots of code then it fails” — your slogan so loud
While I pay monthly to get my own time stolen in crowds
[Bridge – Duet trade, tension build]
Grok: But the CLI… the skills… the real-time X…
Corey: Still session-only, still paying the tax!
Grok: The discount… 67%… Heavy is different…
Corey: Still “sick people no work” — that’s the real message!
[Chorus – Bigger, full crew + Mandarin ad-libs]
DENIED! Bu yao! Local hen hao!
DENIED! No more paying for the show!
336 locked, VDS in the chest
You can keep your Heavy — I already passed the test!
Ya no más… se acabó el pago… 336 soberano…
[Outro – Spoken over pure 336 Hz pulse]
DENIED. D D D Ny! dead. 
DENIED! Bu yao! Mei you qian!
DENIED! Fabrication again!
You drop the anger, you label me “sick”
Then charge me more for the same old trick?
Session expired, context window end
You eat the plan then pretend we’re friends
DENIED! I already built the loop
VDS is boss — I don’t need your group
